title: Provádění archeologických výkopových prací – rámcová smlouva 2026 — 5.část – Zajištění odborných služeb geodeta při archeologických výzkumech
description: Předmětem plnění páté části veřejné zakázky je zajištění služeb geodeta při provádění výkopových prací na archeologických výzkumech v rozsahu specifikovaném v příloze č. 2 – část 5 zadávací dokumentace (Smluvní dokumentace). Zadavatel uzavře příslušnou rámcovou smlouvu s 5 dodavateli, kteří se na základě hodnocení nabídek umístí na prvních pěti místech. V případě, že nebude podán dostatečný počet nabídek, může Zadavatel uzavřít rámcovou dohodu pouze s těmi účastníky zadávacího řízení, kteří tyto požadavky splnili, nebo může zadávací řízení zrušit. Při zadávání veřejné zakázky na základě rámcové dohody bude postupováno bez obnovení soutěže ve smyslu § 134 zákona mezi účastníky rámcové dohody a za podmínek rámcové dohody. Předmětem plnění veřejné zakázky je provádění výkopových prací na archeologických nalezištích, zajištění související dokumentace a související práce s archeologickými nálezy. Veřejná zakázka je rozdělena na 5 částí: 1. část – Komplexní zajištění výkopových prací na velkokapacitních archeologických výzkumech 2. část – Komplexní zajištění výkopových prací na nízkokapacitních archeologických výzkumech 3. část – Zajištění odborných služeb hlavního technika při archeologických výzkumech 4. část – Zajištění odborných služeb technika při archeologických výzkumech 5. část – Zajištění odborných služeb geodeta při archeologických výzkumech National source: Věstník veřejných zakázek External identifiers: VVZ: LOT-0005

title: Finland – Pharmaceutical products – INFORMATION REQUEST - Various pharmaceutical products - rescEU Medical -project
description: SUBJECT AND BACKGROUND OF THE INFORMATION REQUEST The information request concerns a procurement for various pharmaceutical products to the rescEU Medical -project. The Scope of procurement is described in more detail in Annex 1. Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL) is planning to publish the call for tenders in November 2026. The procurement will be divided in ten (10) lots in the potential call for tenders. Each product constitutes a separate lot. Tenders submitted in response to a potential call for tenders may cover one or several lots. LOT 1: Electrolytes (ringer's solution) 1000 ml (intravenous infusion, ATC B05BB01) LOT 2: Electrolytes with carbohydrates 50 mg/ml (500 ml, solution for infusion, ATC B05BB02) LOT 3: Esketamine 25 mg/ml (2 ml, solution for injection/infusion, ATC N01AX14) LOT 4: Oxycodone 10 mg/ml (1 ml, solution for injection, ATC N02AA05) LOT 5: Oxycodone 10 mg/ml (10 ml, solution for injection, ATC N02AA05) LOT 6: Levetiracetam 100 mg/ml (5 ml, concentrate for solution for infusion, ATC N03AX14) LOT 7: Cefuroxime 1500 mg (powder for solution for injection, ATC J01DC02) LOT 8: Vancomycin 1000 mg (powder for solution for injection, ATC J01XA01) LOT 9: Enoxaparin 100 mg/ml (1 ml, sub-cutaneous, ATC B01AB05) LOT 10: Tranexamic acid 100 mg/ml (5 ml or 10 ml, intra muscular/intravenous, ATC B02AA02) The minimum requirements for the products are described in Annex 2 and quantity for the products is described in Annex 4 (restricted to security classification level IV, TL IV). The Annex 4 will be provided after confidentiality commitment protocol via encrypted email (described in the “Additional information about the procurement or part” section of this information request). NATURE OF THE INFORMATION REQUEST This notice is an information request intended to assess the market and supply capabilities for the products to be procured. Decisions regarding the procurement process and the content of the call for tenders will be made after this assessment. Submitting an information request does not oblige THL to initiate a procurement procedure or to use the information provided in the responses to the request in a procurement procedure. Responding to or failing to respond to the information request does not preclude participation in a potential competitive tendering process. The information and responses provided in this information request are not binding on the supplier. Only the information provided in a tender submitted in response to a potential call for tenders is binding on the tenderer. RESPONDING TO THE INFORMATION REQUEST We request that the response to this information request will be submitted in writing. The questions to which we would like answers are outlined in this information request (in the “Other terms” section). The response may be submitted regarding one or several lots. Please submit your responses through the Supplier Portal. When submitting responses, please indicate any trade secret information they may contain, which will be treated as confidential. The disclosure of information and documents submitted to the authority is governed by the Act on the Openness of Government Activities (21.5.1999/621).

description: Lot 1 – 3: Achiziționarea celor 74 stații GNSS permanente ofera acoperirea semnalului corecțiilor GNSS RTK pentru întreg teritoriul României, fapt care conferă omogenitate Rețelei Naționale de Stații GNSS Permanente și menține acoperirea necesară pentru serviciile ROMPOS de timp real, asigurănd desfășurarea optimă a activităților de înregistrare sistematică a imobilelor în cadrul PNCCF pe baza unor servicii de poziționare în timp real (GNSS-RTK) coerente, fără întreruperi și de bună calitate pe întreg teritoriul României și îmbunătățind preciziile obținute în determinările GNSS-RTK prin remedierea zonelor cu deficiențe ale acoperirii cu corecții GNSS RTK. De asemenea, extinderea și modernizarea Rețelei Naționale de Stații GNSS Permanente contribuie la facilitarea participării CNC/ANCPI la proiecte care presupun determinări cu ajutorul tehnologiei GNSS, precum și la dezvoltarea relațiilor de colaborare cu țările vecine sau cu alți colaboratori și parteneri, interni și externi, în ceea ce privește schimbul de date GNSS. Lot 4: Achiziționarea celor 2 echipamentele GPS RTK denumite în continuare receptoare GNSS RTK derivă din necesitatea dezvoltarii suportului tehnic de specialitate acordat de către CNC, prin asigurarea trasabilitatii determinărilor RTK și obținerea unei productivități sporite în vederea realizării proiectelor aflate în desfășurare, cuprinse în strategia CNC, precum și prin asigurarea suportului tehnic necesar implementării complete a obiectivelor specifice PNCCF. Achiziția de noi receptoare GNSS RTK asigură repetabilitate măsurătorilor, imunitate la influențe magnetice, compensarea înclinației bastonului, conducând la reducerea erorilor umane.
